breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification did not eliminate the conflicting half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack instruction. Instead, it split the two contradictory instructions across different steps (gamma-centered for vc-relax/scf, half-shifted MP for nscf/bands). The ground truth resolves this by removing the half-shift Monkhorst-Pack specification entirely and retaining only the gamma-centered k-point grid instruction without qualification.
